text:
Items before: Greek yogurt cup (~150 g, likely a single-serve of about 5.3 oz), blueberries (~70 g), one slice of toast (~35 g), avocado wedge (~40 g), water (not counted).

After: yogurt mostly eaten with some residue left, blueberries gone with a bit of yogurt in the bowl (the blueberries may have been mixed with yogurt), toast eaten with a few crumbs, avocado eaten with a smear left.

Calories: yogurt, Greek 2% or so, 150 g at ~75 kcal/100 g gives ~110 kcal. Blueberries, 70 g at 57 kcal/100 g gives ~40 kcal. Toast, 35 g at ~90 kcal. Avocado, 40 g at 160 kcal/100 g gives ~64 kcal, though a small wedge is perhaps 35 g for ~56 kcal.

Total ≈ 110 + 40 + 90 + 56 = 296 kcal, minus a little for leftovers, so ~285 kcal.

Mass: 150 + 70 + 35 + 35 = 290 g, minus leftovers of about 10 g gives ~280 g.
